items.title: Finalize Partner Showcase content & metrics
items.description: Coordinate with marketing to insert final copy, case-study metrics, and CTA language into the selected mockup (Option B).

items.title: Confirm Partner Showcase CTA destinations
items.description: Verify all CTA buttons link to the correct contact/scheduling workflows before staging deployment.

items.title: Complete Visual QA rerun with system Chrome
items.description: Rerun Playwright visual QA with CHROME_PATH set to the local Chrome binary so we have a passing automated report.

items.title: Configure GA4 tracking and conversion goals
items.description: Set up GA4 property for the Partner Showcase UI and configure conversion goals before going live.

items.title: Deploy Partner Showcase to staging
items.description: Run vercel deploy --preview and validate the preview environment.

items.title: Conduct stakeholder review
items.description: Schedule a review session with partnerships/BD using partner-showcase-pack.md.

items.title: Launch Partner Showcase to production
items.description: Run vercel --prod, confirm DNS, and perform post-launch smoke tests.
